cli.usage:
Usage: grok-companion.mjs <setup|review|adversarial-review|audit|task|imagine> [options] [prompt]
Review: --base <ref> --scope <auto|working-tree|branch> --language <tag> --model <model> --cwd <path> --json
Review scopes auto and working-tree require Windows and fail if a complete safe snapshot cannot be collected.
On macOS/Linux, use --scope branch or --base <ref> for committed changes; uncommitted changes are excluded from the comparison diff, but surrounding files may still be read from the working tree. Use audit for the whole repository.
Task: --model <model> --effort <low|medium|high> --cwd <path> --prompt-file <path> --write --json
Imagine: --model <model> --effort <low|medium|high> --cwd <path> --prompt-file <path> --output <path> --aspect <ratio> --image-model <id> --image-edit-model <id> --allow-api-billing --json
Each command runs a new foreground Grok session. For resuming, use Grok's own resume command.
cli.disabled: {name} is no longer supported. Use Grok's own commands to resume or manage sessions.
cli.prompt_required: A prompt is required for this Grok run.
cli.unsupported_effort: Unsupported reasoning effort. Use low, medium, or high.
setup.update_grok: Update Grok Build with `grok update`, then run setup again.
setup.install_grok: Install Grok Build with `{command}`, then run setup again.
setup.authenticate: Authenticate with `grok login` (or `grok login --device-auth`), or configure XAI_API_KEY, then run setup again.
diag.usage_exhausted: Grok's usage balance is exhausted (HTTP 402). Retry after the balance recovers.
diag.stop_unconfirmed: Grok agent stop could not be confirmed.
diag.turn_incomplete: Grok turn did not complete (status: {status}, stop reason: {stopReason}).
diag.permission_denied: Permission requests denied in this run: {count}
render.stopped_before_result: Review incomplete; Grok stopped before returning a final structured result.
render.invalid_json: Grok did not return valid structured JSON.
render.unexpected_shape: Grok returned JSON with an unexpected review shape.
render.incomplete_notice: Review incomplete; this result must not be treated as approval.
render.no_verified_findings: No verified findings; inspection is incomplete.
diag.image_entitlement: Grok Build's image tools are not available for this sign-in. The account reported that these tools need a SuperGrok subscription. On The X Subscription, Imagine uses the shared weekly usage pool; with an xAI API key, re-run with --allow-api-billing only if you accept per-image API billing.
imagine.api_billing_required: Image generation with XAI_API_KEY is billed at xAI API rates ({model} is listed from {price}), not from the subscription usage pool. Re-run with --allow-api-billing to continue.
imagine.api_billing_notice: API key sign-in: image generation is billed at xAI API rates ({model} is listed from {price}), not from the subscription usage pool.
imagine.subscription_pool: Subscription sign-in: image generation draws from the account's shared weekly usage pool, not per-image API billing.
imagine.no_image: Grok did not return a generated image from its session images directory.
imagine.untrusted_path: Refused to copy a reported image path outside Grok's session images directory.
imagine.copy_failed: Could not copy the generated image: {detail}.
imagine.partial_copy: Saved {saved} image(s), then stopped copying the rest: {detail}
imagine.output_escapes: The output path must stay inside the workspace: {path}.
imagine.output_unusable: The output path is not a usable directory: {path}.
imagine.bad_aspect: Unsupported aspect ratio: {ratio}. Use one of {ratios}.
imagine.bad_image_model: Invalid image model ID for {option}: {value}. Use only letters, digits, ".", "_" and "-", starting with a letter or digit.
imagine.no_repo_write: imagine does not edit the repository. It only copies generated images into the output directory.
imagine.extension_mismatch: The output extension {output} does not match the generated image extension {source}. The bytes are not converted, so the extension is left unchanged.
err.grok_missing_agent_stdio: This Grok Build version does not expose `grok agent stdio`. Update it with `grok update`, then rerun `/grok:setup`.
err.grok_not_installed: Grok Build is not installed. Install it with `{windows}` (Windows) or `{unix}`, then rerun `/grok:setup`.
err.git_not_a_repository: This command must run inside a Git repository.
err.git_not_installed: git is not installed. Install Git and retry.
err.git_cwd_unavailable: Unable to start Git: the working directory is unavailable.
err.git_too_old: Git 2.45 or newer with --no-lazy-fetch support is required for read-only operations. Update Git and retry; automatic fetching remains disabled.
err.git_base_with_repo_scope: --base does not apply to --scope repo. A repository audit reviews the whole source, not a diff.
err.git_unsupported_scope: Unsupported review scope "{scope}". Use one of: auto, working-tree, branch, repo, or pass --base <ref>.
err.git_default_branch_undetected_win: Unable to detect the repository default branch. Pass --base <ref> or use --scope working-tree (requires a complete safe snapshot).
err.git_default_branch_undetected: Unable to detect the repository default branch. Pass --base <ref> to review committed changes; uncommitted changes are excluded from the comparison diff, but surrounding files may still be read from the working tree. Use a repository audit to review the whole source.
diag.effort_no_selector: This Grok build exposes no reasoning effort selector; --effort {effort} was not applied.
diag.effort_not_offered: Reasoning effort {effort} is not offered (available: {available}); leaving it unchanged.
diag.effort_no_values: Reasoning effort {effort} cannot be applied: the selector has no selectable values; leaving it unchanged.
err.snapshot_guidance_non_windows: Working-tree reviews are unavailable on this platform. Use --scope branch or --base to review committed changes; uncommitted changes are excluded from the comparison diff, but surrounding files may still be read from the working tree.
err.snapshot_unreadable: cannot safely read the working tree snapshot.
err.snapshot_head_unavailable: unborn or unavailable HEAD is unsupported.
err.snapshot_config_unsupported: unsupported working tree normalization or stat configuration.
err.snapshot_filemode: core.filemode must be explicitly false because executable mode cannot be observed safely.
err.snapshot_index_entry: unsupported, unmerged, sparse, skip-worktree or submodule index entry.
err.snapshot_attributes_unsupported: unsupported external conversion or normalization attribute.
err.snapshot_blob_lossless: blob content is not complete lossless UTF-8.
err.snapshot_blob_size: immutable blob evidence exceeds the snapshot size limit.
err.snapshot_binary_conversion: unsupported binary or non-UTF-8 automatic line conversion.
err.snapshot_crlf_index: unsupported CR or CRLF content in the existing index blob.
err.snapshot_mixed_eol: unsupported mixed or bare-CR automatic line conversion.
err.snapshot_changed_binary: changed binary or non-UTF-8 content cannot be reviewed completely.
err.snapshot_changed_during: working tree or metadata changed during collection.
err.snapshot_inline_size: complete working tree evidence exceeds the inline size limit.
err.review_worktree_filters: cannot safely inspect the working tree because Git clean/process filters may execute external commands. Use an explicit branch comparison or repository scope.
err.review_submodule_diff: inline submodule diffs may execute child Git textconv commands.
err.review_branch_objects: unable to resolve immutable branch comparison objects.
err.review_branch_modes: unable to validate the branch comparison file modes.
err.review_branch_submodule: changed submodule contents cannot be safely collected without child Git textconv execution.
err.review_no_final_message: Grok did not return a final structured message.
err.acp_handshake_timeout: Grok agent did not complete the ACP handshake within {ms}ms.
err.acp_client_closed: grok agent stdio client is closed.
err.acp_pipes_missing: Grok supervisor did not provide all required stdio pipes.
err.windows_owner_identity: Windows agent owner identity could not be pinned before startup.
err.windows_supervisor_exited: Windows owned agent supervisor exited before startup was confirmed.
err.windows_supervisor_timeout: Windows owned agent supervisor startup timed out.
err.windows_arch: Unsupported architecture for the Windows helper.
err.perm_webfetch_http: WebFetch requires an HTTP(S) URL without credentials
err.perm_tool_unknown: the tool is not explicitly known to be read-only
err.perm_no_allow_option: no one-time read-only permission option is available
err.perm_imagine_no_option: no one-time permission option is available for image generation
err.perm_imagine_only: imagine only allows the image generation tool
err.perm_acp_write_denied: ACP file write request was denied
err.perm_writes_file: writes to a file or edits in place
err.perm_unicode_quotes: uses Unicode quotation marks that some shells treat as string delimiters
err.perm_control_chars: uses control or format characters that shells may split differently
err.perm_shell_syntax: uses unsupported shell control or expansion syntax
err.perm_shell_quoting: uses unsupported shell quoting or unquoted expression syntax
err.perm_executable_path: uses an executable path outside the command allowlist
err.perm_test_path: Test-Path requires one literal path within the repository
err.perm_path_escape: uses an absolute path or a path that may leave the repository
err.perm_git_global_options: git requires the explicit read-only global options shown in the review instructions
err.perm_git_unrestricted: git {sub} cannot be safely restricted to repository objects
err.perm_git_diff_range: git diff requires --cached, --staged or an exact OID..OID range immediately after the read-only diff options; fixed ranges require explicit -- before paths
err.perm_git_grep_cached: git grep requires --cached as its first argument
err.perm_git_ls_files_modified: git ls-files modified checks may invoke worktree filters
err.perm_git_no_textconv: git diff/log/show/whatchanged require --no-ext-diff and --no-textconv as the first two subcommand arguments
err.perm_git_option: git uses an unsupported option, abbreviation or short-option combination
err.perm_not_allowlisted: {head} is not on the read-only allowlist
err.perm_sed_script: sed script is not a line-range print
err.perm_command_misuse: {head} is being used in a way that can write or run other commands
err.stop_unconfirmed_direct: Direct Grok agent stop could not be confirmed.
err.prompt_unverified: The prompt response could not be verified against the issued request.
err.prompt_no_terminal: The prompt response did not contain a recognized terminal reason.
err.prompt_non_error: The prompt failed with a non-Error value.
err.acp_jsonl_parse: Failed to parse grok agent JSONL: {detail}
